text:
LB_QUEUED
Description
LB_QUEUED is a
serverside
event
triggered when a connection limit is hit at
the pool or pool member level. HTTP redirection is permissible in this
event, but
HTTP::retry
is not. If the queue
limit is exceeded,
LB_FAILED
will be triggered.
Examples
when
LB_QUEUED
{
log
local0.
"[IP::local_addr] was queued - [LB::queue depth one
pool1] / [LB::queue limit depth pool1]"
}
